result.journal: International Journal of Emerging Technologies in Learning (iJET)
result.keywords: This study investigates an adaptive digital game learning model for English vocabulary acquisition that personalizes practice according to learners’ proficiency level. A diagnostic pre-test was used to classify participants into elementary, intermediate, and advanced groups, after which the system delivered context-based game activities and differentiated feedback. The study focused on Asian learners and examined how game scenario, learner background, and learning stage influenced vocabulary gains. Results indicated that adaptive sequencing improved performance most strongly for intermediate and advanced learners, while elementary learners showed modest but steady progress. The findings suggest that combining knowledge-level adaptation with educational games can support more effective English vocabulary learning in technology-enhanced environments.
result.title: Adaptive Digital Game Learning for English Vocabulary Based on Proficiency Level
